newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to re-offer Mata marginal field Aug 20.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to re-offer Mata marginal field Aug 20.

text.p: Venezuela's Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) will re-auction the Mata marginal oil field operating contract on August 20, leading daily El Nacional reported.

Local companies Pivensa and PBE Trading Company were stripped of the field they won at auction in June with a $90 million bid. Their offer beat-out by just three million dollars the second highest bid from Argentina's Perez Companc and Venezuela's Corporacion Corepli.
The Venezuelan consortium was disqualified after another company bought out 75 percent of PBE Trading shares without informing PDVSA.
PBE Trading has been barred from the new auction, although Pivensa may participate. The Mata field currently produces 600 barrels per day and has proven reserves of 101 million barrels.
